rules.source: (rewrite (Concat (Concat a b) c) (Concat a (Concat b c)) :ruleset always-run)
(rewrite (SubTuple expr a b) (Concat (Single (Get expr a)) (SubTuple expr (+ a 1) (- b 1))) :when ((> b 1)) :ruleset always-run)

(rule ((Get expr i))
      ((union (Single (Get expr i)) (SubTuple expr i 1)))
        :ruleset always-run )
(rewrite (Concat (SubTuple expr a b) (SubTuple expr (+ a b) c)) (SubTuple expr a (+ b c)) :ruleset always-run)
